whenever step_return & closure_provided RMSpropTFLikeNumerics shall immediately satisfy returned_loss = closure_loss & !returns_none.

whenever step_return RMSpropTFLikeNumerics shall immediately satisfy effective_gradient = raw_gradient + weight_decay * old_parameter & squared_average = alpha * old_squared_average + (1 - alpha) * effective_gradient * effective_gradient.

whenever step_return & (denominator > 0) & (momentum = 0) RMSpropTFLikeNumerics shall immediately satisfy new_parameter = old_parameter - lr * effective_gradient / denominator.

whenever step_return & (denominator > 0) & (momentum != 0) RMSpropTFLikeNumerics shall immediately satisfy new_buffer = momentum * old_buffer + effective_gradient / denominator & new_parameter = old_parameter - lr * new_buffer.
